summary: Prudential plc furnished a routine Form 6-K carrying a UK MAR Article 19 PDMR notification: Chair Douglas Flint acquired 11,000 ordinary shares of 5 pence each (ISIN GB0007099541) on 2026-11-06 at GBP 9.22 per share, an aggregate consideration of roughly GBP 101,420, executed on the London Stock Exchange. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, stake threshold or structural mechanic is disclosed, and no special-situation event is present. The filing is an ordinary insider-dealing disclosure equivalent to a US Form 4; nothing here alters the deal landscape, so no risk-arb angle applies.
